start.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

				local prefix = "SCRIPT  BY KARTIK+ATUL 😈 "
				local middle = "["..target.."] "..msg

				-- Roblox safe limit
				local maxLen = 180

				-- calculate usable chars
				local used = #prefix + #middle + 4
				local remaining = maxLen - used

				if remaining < 0 then
					remaining = 0
				end

				local half = math.floor(remaining / 2)
				local safeLine = ""

				while #safeLine + #style <= half do
					safeLine = safeLine .. style
				end

				local finalMessage = prefix .. "\n" .. safeLine .. "\n" .. middle .. "\n" .. safeLine

				send(finalMessage)
				task.wait(delay)
			end
		end
	end)
end)
